recommendations.current: First, the signal is small relative to any leak. Total variance of log tau is about 0.85 and the residual after fixed effects about 0.28. Even if the neighbour-own horizon gap had the full cross-sectional variance, a 0.06 peer response would generate quarterly variation of about 0.06 squared times 0.85, or 0.003, roughly 1% of residual variance, so a correlated-effects leak of that size would reproduce it: quarter fixed effects remove only the average loading on a common turnover factor, not style-specific loadings. Second, with institution fixed effects, a lagged dependent variable and about 50 quarters, the Nickell approximation (the bias of within estimators in short dynamic panels) puts the bias on persistence near (1 + 0.75)/(50 - 1), about 0.036, part of which homophily loads onto the peer coefficient; exclusion bias runs the other way [57], so the net sign is unknown. Third, widening the network from top-5 to top-10 raises the median friends-of-friends count from 32-42 to about 60-70 (the project's own data), so many measured intransitive friends-of-friends are real peers cut by an arbitrary threshold, which the Chandrasekhar-Lewis mechanism covers as much as node sampling [8]; the full universe then pushes toward the dense regime where instruments are weak [58]. Fourth, merger shocks are discredited [47, 48, 49], no paper located shows that a large filer's turnover moves when one manager leaves, the churn ratio is stable for institutions across time [19], and most trade directions are predictable from managers' own history [53]. A null in a reflection-plus-exclusion setting is uninformative [9, 57].

- **Second**, with institution fixed effects, a lagged dependent variable and about 50 quarters, the Nickell approximation (the bias of within estimators in short dynamic panels) puts the bias on persistence near (1 + 0.75)/(50 - 1), about 0.036, part of which homophily loads onto the peer coefficient; exclusion bias runs the other way [57], so the net sign is unknown.
- **Third**, widening the network from top-5 to top-10 raises the median friends-of-friends count from 32-42 to about 60-70 (the project's own data), so many measured intransitive friends-of-friends are real peers cut by an arbitrary threshold, which the Chandrasekhar-Lewis mechanism covers as much as node sampling [8]; the full universe then pushes toward the dense regime where instruments are weak [58].
- **Fourth**, merger shocks are discredited [47, 48, 49], no paper located shows that a large filer's turnover moves when one manager leaves, the churn ratio is stable for institutions across time [19], and most trade directions are predictable from managers' own history [53].

recommendations.current: If the estimate is positive and survives the shock design, three implications follow. First, the crisis effects of short-horizon ownership [19, 20] carry a network multiplier that fragility measures built from flow covariances [43] and overlap counts [23] do not see: shocks shortening a cluster of neighbours' horizons should predict fragility in the stocks that cluster holds. Second, the passive transition reshapes the network itself. Even a personal shock can push an active manager toward quasi-indexing [10], so contagion predicts that shifts toward long horizons spread too, a testable claim about how passive behaviour diffuses. Third, agent-based finance gains an adaptation parameter estimated from holdings rather than chosen to match return moments [24, 36]. A precise zero is also informative: it settles whether institutional horizon is a trait and tells modellers to treat horizon change as wealth-driven selection [89] rather than imitation.

- **Second**, the passive transition reshapes the network itself. Even a personal shock can push an active manager toward quasi-indexing [10], so contagion predicts that shifts toward long horizons spread too, a testable claim about how passive behaviour diffuses.

recommendations.current: Five rules follow. (1) Build Gaspar-Massa-Matos churn from share changes at current prices, with the Yan-Zhang minimum-of-buys-and-sells variant as robustness [15, 21], and retire value-weight tau. (2) Rescale reported values for filings before January 3, 2023, by filing date rather than report quarter, since the jump's location suggests mixed vintages within 2022Q4 (the project's own data), or avoid the value field. (3) Clean amendments, notice filings, put and call rows, shares versus principal and CUSIP errors, since the SEC publishes the data as filed [11]. (4) Build the network on the full universe and keep the top filers only as an estimation subsample. (5) Note that 2013Q2, the current sample's first quarter, precedes the data sets [11].
recommendations.recommended:

1. Build Gaspar-Massa-Matos churn from share changes at current prices, with the Yan-Zhang minimum-of-buys-and-sells variant as robustness [15, 21], and retire value-weight tau.
2. Rescale reported values for filings before January 3, 2023, by filing date rather than report quarter, since the jump's location suggests mixed vintages within 2022Q4 (the project's own data), or avoid the value field.
3. Clean amendments, notice filings, put and call rows, shares versus principal and CUSIP errors, since the SEC publishes the data as filed [11].

5. Note that 2013Q2, the current sample's first quarter, precedes the data sets [11].

recommendations.current: Controls are institution fixed effects; style-by-quarter fixed effects, with style given by Bushee type (the classification of institutions into quasi-indexers, dedicated and transient investors from annual averages of 13F reports [80]) or an AUM-by-concentration cell; own and neighbours' flows and AUM growth; Pastor-Stambaugh-Taylor same-category averages [6]; and exclusion of same-parent and same-family neighbours. Placebos are future neighbours (links formed at t+4), matched non-neighbours of the same style and size, and neighbour horizon computed from held stocks, which should be larger if mechanics dominate.
